slots.name: goal
slots.about: the day's goal in units; 0 means no goal, and the ring and goal line give way to the count alone

slots.name: max_back
slots.about: how many days back the day arrows reach

slots.name: quick
slots.about: quick-add amounts: id (1 up), amount (more than 0); 0 or more, with none the quick row is left out

slots.name: day_line
slots.about: the day between the arrows; may read offset (days back from today)

slots.name: unit_line
slots.about: the unit under the count; may read count

slots.name: goal_line
slots.about: the line under the dial; may read count, goal, pct (share of the goal, not capped), met and over_by

slots.name: no_goal_line
slots.about: the line under the dial when goal is 0; may read count

slots.name: week_line
slots.about: the quiet line under the goal line; may read week_met (days in the last 7 that met the goal)

slots.name: quick_ask
slots.about: the heading over the quick-add row

slots.name: quick_label
slots.about: each quick button's words; may read it.amount

slots.name: add
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: one more on the shown day

slots.name: take
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: one less on the shown day, never under 0

slots.name: quick_add
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: adds the button's amount (value: it.amount) on the shown day

slots.name: back
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: one day back, up to max_back

slots.name: forward
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: one day forward, never past today

empty.shows: the count reads 0, the ring is empty and minus is dimmed and does nothing

attention.shows: the ring is full, a check sits under the unit, and the goal line says met or how far over

fallback.shows: no ring and no share; the count and the no-goal line only

accessibility.reduce_motion: the phone drops smooth, swap, rise and shrink
accessibility.not_colour_alone: the goal met is a check plus words, the share is said in the goal line, and a dimmed arrow or minus does nothing
